note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a ISR 5; A06b ISR 5; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 3 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Israel, 2024
sources.said: Person is in Israel and has been resident there for 3 out of the 5 years immediately preceding the day of the submission of the application. Person is entitled to reside in Israel permanently, has settled (or intends to settle) in Israel. ... Person must have renounced citizenship of another country or proven his/her willingness to do so upon becoming a citizen. ... n.a.
